en.title: Dusky Night, the Sea-Roar Circuit
en.premise:
“Detective, where did that child go?”

On a rainy night, a woman draped in despair knocks on my office door. Her missing brother's footprints lead to an old, forbidden lighthouse. There, I encounter a locked room that defies the laws of physics and the electronic fragments of a "lost AI" that should have long been decommissioned. Through the haze of cigarette smoke, I begin to chase the blood-scented truth hidden by that ghost.

zh.title: 铅灰色的夜晚，海鸣回路
zh.premise:
「侦探先生，那孩子去哪儿了？」

——雨夜里，敲响事务所大门的，是一位身披绝望的女子。失踪弟弟的足迹，一直延伸向那座禁止进入的旧灯塔。在那里，存在着仿佛在嘲弄物理法则的密室，以及本该被废弃的“迷路人工智能”，正化作电子碎片漂浮其中。在烟雾缭绕的视线中，我开始追寻那幽灵所掩盖的、带着血腥味的真相。
